_comment: Starter Claude Code settings for LLM Orchestrator. install.sh --copy seeds <project>/.claude/settings.json from this file when none exists; you can also merge it into ~/.claude/settings.json (per-user) by hand. Adjust paths and permissions to taste.
_permissions_note: Three kinds of rules were removed from earlier versions of this template because they cannot fire. (1) 'Bash(curl * | sh)': Bash rules are matched against each pipe-split subcommand, so a pattern that itself contains a pipe matches neither side — it denied nothing. (2) 'Bash(git push --force:*)': ':*' is a trailing wildcard, so 'git push origin main --force' was not matched; flag position cannot be expressed in these patterns. Every push, forced or not, is intercepted by the 'Bash(git push:*)' ask rule instead. (3) 'Write(*)' / 'Glob(*)' / 'Grep(*)': path rules are consulted for Edit and Read only — rules naming other tools are accepted, never consulted, and warn at startup.
_safety_note: The two hard guards have deliberate, individually named escape hatches, set in the environment (not in this file) when a human really means it. ORCH_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_GIT=1 disarms guard-destructive-git — that guard intentionally ignores ORCH_DISABLED_HOOKS and ORCH_HOOK_PROFILE, because a guard against losing uncommitted work must not share an off switch with style hooks. ORCH_ALLOW_CONFIG_EDIT=1 disarms guard-config-protection. ORCH_CADENCE_UNLOCK=1 is not a hook hatch: it is the cadence's own unlock, read by cadence-init and by orch-cadence-check.sh --lock so a numbered amendment can rewrite the laws and re-record the manifest, and both refuse it outright when any settings file in scope contains the string ORCH_CADENCE_UNLOCK, because a persisted unlock is a disarmed lock. See docs/install.md, 'Escape hatches for the hard guards'.
_handoff_note: ORCH_CONTEXT_HANDOFF_TOKENS is the token count at which the agent is reminded once to write a handoff note (a short status file) so a long task can continue cleanly after Claude Code compacts the conversation. Default 950000 (~95% of a 1M-token window), just below the point where native compaction kicks in. Lower it for a smaller window. You can also write the note anytime with /llm-orchestrator:handoff.
_hooks_note: If you installed via --copy (not as a plugin), add hook entries here using Claude Code's settings.json hook schema. See 'Wiring hooks for a --copy install' in docs/install.md — install.sh --copy ships that file to .claude/docs/install.md so the reference resolves inside the installed tree. If you installed as a plugin, hooks come from hooks/hooks.json automatically — leave the hooks block out.
